title: Measure the grown held-out file's answer rate once and set the fitness test floor from it
goal: The held-out file's pass count is measured once on the tip that holds TK-hsbjikhg's rows, its failing ids and date in this item's notes and its failing rows left as committed; and kb/_self/tools.md and kb/_self/token-efficiency.md give the fitness test's --min as gate floor's answer computes it from that count, beside the Rate line (at least F of N, measured M of N on DATE), at which the fitness test passes

run: import re,csv,sys,subprocess;t=open('kb/_self/tools.md',encoding='utf-8').read()+open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md',encoding='utf-8').read();m=set(re.findall(r'lookup_heldout\.csv --root public --min (\d+)',t));n=len(list(csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv',encoding='utf-8'))));r=re.search(r'Rate: at least (\d+) of (\d+); measured (\d+) of (\d+)',t);print(m,n,r and r.groups());ok=n>=95 and len(m)==1 and r and int(r.group(2))==n==int(r.group(4)) and r.group(1)==next(iter(m)) and int(r.group(3))>=int(r.group(1));sys.exit(1 if not ok else subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','eval','--file','kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv','--root','public','--min',next(iter(m))]).returncode)

import subprocess,sys,csv,io;f='kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv';log=subprocess.run(['git','log','--reverse','--format=%H','ae319c43c5..HEAD','--',f],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split();rows=lambda r:subprocess.run(['git','show',r+':'+f],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;first=next((c for c in log if len(list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(rows(c)))))>=95),None);print('first grown commit:',first);sys.exit(0 if first and rows(first)==open(f,encoding='utf-8').read() else 1)

gates.question: Which --min floor does the held-out fitness test take, given the pass count M of N rows measured once on the grown file?
options: measured-minus-5: --min = M minus 5 (at most 5 rows may regress before the test fails), and Rate: at least M-5 of N; measured M of N
measured: --min = M (any regressed row fails the test)
ratio-80: --min = 80% of N, the 16-of-20 ratio kept (fails at once if M is below it)
gates.recommendation: measured-minus-5: --min = M minus 5 (at most 5 rows may regress before the test fails), and Rate: at least M-5 of N; measured M of N
gates.answer: measured-minus-5: --min = M minus 5 (at most 5 rows may regress before the test fails), and Rate: at least M-5 of N; measured M of N
